Metadata.title: SmartSakuu | Run the school. Understand every learner.
Metadata.description: SmartSakuu connects school operations, teaching, student learning and AI support in one student record. Built with Ghanaian schools, for African education.

Problem.label: The problem
Problem.title: A school sees the score. But not always the story behind it.
Problem.body: Admissions, fees, examinations, attendance and learning often sit in separate systems. Staff have to piece a learner’s story together before they can understand what is happening. By then, the term may be over.

score.title:
Mathematics,

end of term.
score.body: The number gives the result. It doesn’t explain a persistent algebra gap, too little practice, or another pattern that needs attention.
score.caption: There is more to this learner’s story.

mastery.empty: The specific learning gap isn’t visible.

evidence.resultEmpty: The next step stays unclear until someone collects the evidence by hand.

Why.label: Why this matters
Why.title: Every learning gap deserves an earlier response.
Why.body: Ghana’s learning challenge makes timely insight urgent. Connecting what a school already knows can help teachers see who needs support, and where to start.

literacy.body: of children do not achieve basic literacy and numeracy by the end of primary school.

lines: • JHS 2B — 9 learners scored below 40% on linear equations, and it has been two weeks since the topic was re-taught.

lines: JHS 2B and JHS 3A are furthest behind in mathematics this term.

• In JHS 3A, 11 learners are below the BECE-ready mark in number and fractions.

example.question: “How has Mathematics performance changed over the last three years?”
example.answer: SmartSakuu can use authorised historical records to surface trends, identify persistent weak areas and connect the answer to relevant classes, assessments and interventions.

Responsible.label: Responsible AI
Responsible.title: AI supports the decision. People remain responsible for it.
Responsible.body: SmartSakuu is designed around human oversight, appropriate access and educational context. Teachers review, edit and approve AI-generated activities before they reach a class.
Responsible.flowLabel: AI drafts, teacher reviews, teacher approves

control.title: Teacher control
control.body: Lesson plans, notes, quizzes and activities stay under teacher review and adaptation.

access.title: Role-based access
access.body: A parent sees their own child. Staff see only the school information their role permits.

support.title: Student support
support.body: AI guides learning and practice. It does not make autonomous high-stakes decisions about a learner.

context.title: Context over generic AI
context.body: Guidance is grounded in the curriculum, learning progress and authorised school information.

Headteachers.label: Headteachers’ stories
Headteachers.title:
Real schools. Real leaders.

A clearer picture.
Headteachers.body: What does a connected school record change for a headteacher? The questions they can ask. The patterns they can see. The learners they can support sooner.

kumasi.videoLabel: A headteacher smiling in front of her classroom whiteboard
kumasi.quote: Mock results arrived in three different spreadsheets. With every assessment in one record, the headteacher could see which JHS 3 learners were slipping in mathematics weeks before BECE, and plan extra support while there was still time.

accra.videoLabel: A school leader standing in a classroom while learners work
accra.quote: Parent meetings used to start with a search for paperwork. Now the head opens one learner’s record — attendance, fees and progress together — and the conversation moves straight to what the family and school will do next.
accra.role: Proprietor and head, private basic school

tamale.videoLabel: An educator checking learners’ written work at their desks
tamale.quote: When two experienced teachers transferred mid-year, their notes on learners didn’t leave with them. The new staff picked up each class with its history intact, and the head could still ask how every group had progressed.

takoradi.videoLabel: A headteacher standing proudly beside a learner
takoradi.quote: Between report cards, families had little to go on. Short progress notes drawn from the same record now go home every fortnight, so fewer conversations at PTA meetings begin with surprise.

Headteachers.disclosure:
Illustrative stories based on common school scenarios, not customer interviews. Approved headteacher testimonials are coming soon.
